We have mass spectrum data: m/z values with intensities. Need to identify elements definitively based on isotope distribution patterns visible. We need to see isotopic peaks pattern: The base peak at 276.066555... intensity 100. Then peaks at +1, +2, etc. The pattern suggests presence of isotopes of certain elements. Need to infer which elements can be definitively identified from pattern.

We have isotopic distribution of common elements: we can retrieve.
